source.title: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun

items.name: Constructed
items.text: Anvaca gains a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against death effects, disease, and poison, as well as to saving throws against effects that would give them the Drained, Paralyzed, or Sickened conditions. They count as a living creature (and can therefore be healed by vitality and harmed by void damage).

items.name: Bolt Emitter
items.text:
Price 900 gp; Ammunition magical energy (unlimited; no reload)

---
Usage mounted on tracks

Space 7 feet long, 5 feet wide, 5 feet high

---
Crew 1–3; Proficiency martial

---
AC 22; Fort +17; Ref +13

Hardness 15; HP 80 (BT 40); Immunities object immunities

---
Speed 15 feet (pushed or pulled along tracks; can't be removed from tracks)

Aim 1 60 feet, minimum distance 10 feet

Fire 1 (attack, flourish, manipulate, range 200 feet) 6d10 electricity, single target, DC 23 Reflex save. On a failed save, the target becomes Clumsy 2 from electric shock.

items.name: Dead, But Not Forgotten
items.text: The countless ghostly echoes that compose Anvaca's spirit surround the poppet's body, then surge out in either a 15-foot emanation or a 60-foot line, dealing 6d10 spirit damage to all creatures in the area (DC 28 basic Reflex save save). Anvaca can't use Dead, But Not Forgotten again for 1d4 rounds.

items.name: Moon-Blessed Hoplite
items.text: Anvaca can wield a longspear in one hand if they're holding a shield in their other hand. Spear weapons Anvaca wields temporarily become +2 greater striking and deal an additional 1d8 spirit damage on a hit.

items.name: Shielded Approach
items.text: Anvaca Raises their Shield, then either Strides or Steps.
